issue.title: Unowned full-lane flakes seen during sase-1q5 phases: fakey gate-capacity join timeout, node-jump page query clear-retry, prompt-bar hot-spare reveal

task_type_fields.evidence:
Three unowned nodes failed in loaded full-lane `just check` runs during epic sase-1q5's phases. Each passed on rerun on the same tree, and none is touched by its phase's diff. They are grouped by evidence, not by a proven shared root cause; the worker should split them by root cause.

- `tests/fakey/test_gate_capacity_custom_e2e.py::test_synchronous_gate_answer_claims_and_releases_runner_slot_capacity_like_an_agent`: `run_gate` was still alive after `join(_WAIT_TIMEOUT)` under a loaded 37-minute scoped suite (sase tool run check abbc07ba4dbb76f4bfddf69ce97d0192, 59,214 passed). An isolated rerun passed in 6 s. Reported by phase sase-1q5.3, note #1.
- `tests/ace/tui/test_node_jump_ladder.py::test_real_ace_page_query_clear_retry_records_the_live_transition`: failed in the full check lane (ToolRun ca21f9a45f6c297a802e8f97a8f40524, 59,205 passed and 3 failed after escalating on core-identity-changed). It passed together with the other failures under xdist on the clean base. Reported by phase sase-1q5.6, note #1.
- `tests/ace/tui/test_prompt_bar_hot_spare.py::test_reveal_matches_fresh_home[pairs1-]`: failed in the 44-minute full check lane (triage FLAKY) but passed in isolation on both the worked and the stashed base trees. Reported by phase sase-1q5.7, note #2.

Fail rate: 1 of 1 loaded full-lane run each, 0 serial or isolated failures. No bead search (node names, file names, error fragments) found an owner on 2026-10-31. Filed by the sase-1q5 land agent.

issue.creation_reason: Three load-sensitive full-lane failures with no owning bead recurred while verifying epic sase-1q5's phases; each passed on rerun and none is related to the epic.
